title: Kernel-based Interpolatory Methods for Context Compression of Attention Mechanisms
abstract: arXiv:2610.40943v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The bottleneck of attention mechanisms, which are the fundamental building block of modern language models, is their quadratic complexity in terms of context size. There has thus been an increasing interest in the compression of the context, also called KV-cache compression. In this article, we consider the problem of compressing the context of attention mechanisms by first formulating it in the Hilbert space associated with its kernel. In this formalism, attention can be represented as the ratio of two linear maps whose interpolant is also the ratio of interpolants, this allows us to consider the interpolation of the linear maps directly. We thus introduce two novel KV-cache compression methods which we call GAIM and Q-DAIM, based on the Generalized Empirical Interpolation Method (GEIM) and the Q-Discrete Empirical Interpolation Method (Q-DEIM), respectively. translated_title: 基于核的插值方法用于注意力机制的上下文压缩
translated_abstract: 注意力机制是现代语言模型的基本构建模块，其瓶颈在于相对于上下文长度的二次方复杂度。因此，上下文压缩（也称为KV缓存压缩）引起了越来越多的关注。在本文中，我们考虑注意力机制上下文压缩的问题，首先在与注意力机制相关联的核所对应的希尔伯特空间中对其进行形式化。在这一形式化框架下，注意力可以表示为两个线性映射之比，而其插值同样是两个插值之比，这使得我们可以直接对线性映射进行插值。据此，我们基于广义经验插值方法（GEIM）和Q-离散经验插值方法（Q-DEIM），分别提出了两种新颖的KV缓存压缩方法，称为GAIM和Q-DAIM。由于这些方法的计算代价与上下文长度呈二次方关系，我们……
tldr: 本文在核所对应的希尔伯特空间中将注意力表示为两个线性映射之比，并分别基于广义经验插值方法（GEIM）和Q-离散经验插值方法（Q-DEIM）提出了两种新颖的KV缓存压缩方法GAIM和Q-DAIM。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates attention in the Hilbert space associated with its kernel as a ratio of two linear maps, and introduces two novel KV-cache compression methods, GAIM and Q-DAIM, based on the Generalized Empirical Interpolation Method (GEIM) and the Q-Discrete Empirical Interpolation Method (Q-DEIM).
